meta.name: request-refactor-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed refactor plan with tiny commits via user interview, then file it as a GitHub issue. Use when user wants to plan a refactor, create a refactoring RFC, or break a refactor into safe incremental steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把重构计划拆成安全的小步骤并提交为 GitHub issue
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把大型重构拆成可安全执行的小提交
copy.tagline_en: Break a refactor plan into safe small commits and file as GitHub issue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to break a large refactor into safe incremental steps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过提问帮你梳理重构需求，然后制定一个由极小提交组成的详细计划，并自动创建 GitHub Issue 来记录。
howto.when: 当你提出想要规划代码重构、创建重构 RFC，或者希望把重构拆成安全的小步骤时触发。

say.text: 我想重构这个模块，帮我做个计划。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问了解你的需求。

say.text: 帮我把这个重构拆成安全的增量步骤。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码并制定小提交计划。

say.text: 创建一个重构 RFC 并提交到 GitHub Issue。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Issue 并提交。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will interview you to understand the refactoring need, then create a detailed plan with tiny commits and file it as a GitHub issue.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to plan a refactor, create a refactoring RFC, or break a refactor into safe incremental steps.

say_en.text: I want to refactor this module, help me make a plan.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions to understand your needs.

say_en.text: Break this refactor into safe incremental steps.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the code and create a plan of tiny commits.

say_en.text: Create a refactoring RFC and file it as a GitHub issue.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the issue and submit it.
